hooks.command: git pull --rebase --autostash -q 2>&1 | tail -3; echo '--- partner commits in last 24h ---'; git log --since=24.hours --oneline --stat -15

git fetch -q 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Partner pushed $n new commit(s) not yet pulled:"; git log --oneline --stat HEAD..@{u}; echo 'Pull with: git pull --rebase --autostash'; fi; exit 0

git add -A && git commit -q -m "chore: auto-sync wip ($(git config user.name))" 2>/dev/null; (git pull --rebase --autostash -q || git rebase --abort) >/dev/null 2>&1; git push -q >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
